Write the whole-module specification

InputClean RTL module: autovcoder_019596.v
InstructionDescribe the whole module’s interface and observable behavior in self-contained prose.

Read input: autovcoder_019596.v · Open raw
module autovcoder_019596 (
    a,
    b,
    ci,
    c1,
    c2,
    c3,
    co
);
  input [3:0] a, b;  //4bits 2 input
  input ci;  //1bit 1 input
  output c1, c2, c3, co;  //output c1,c2,c3,co

  wire [3:0] g, p;  // generate signal, propagate signal

  wire w0_c1;  //use 1 wire in c1
  wire w0_c2, w1_c2;  //use 2 wire in c2
  wire w0_c3, w1_c3, w2_c3;  //use 3 wire in c3
  wire w0_co, w1_co, w2_co, w3_co;  //use 4 wire in co

  _and2 U0_and2 (
      .a(a[0]),
      .b(b[0]),
      .y(g[0])
  );  //Generate
  _and2 U1_and2 (
      .a(a[1]),
      .b(b[1]),
      .y(g[1])
  );
  _and2 U2_and2 (
      .a(a[2]),
      .b(b[2]),
      .y(g[2])
  );
  _and2 U3_and2 (
      .a(a[3]),
      .b(b[3]),
      .y(g[3])
  );

  _or2 U0_or2 (
      .a(a[0]),
      .b(b[0]),
      .y(p[0])
  );  //Propagate
  _or2 U1_or2 (
      .a(a[1]),
      .b(b[1]),
      .y(p[1])
  );
  _or2 U2_or2 (
      .a(a[2]),
      .b(b[2]),
      .y(p[2])
  );
  _or2 U3_or2 (
      .a(a[3]),
      .b(b[3]),
      .y(p[3])
  );

  _and2 C1_and2 (
      .a(p[0]),
      .b(ci),
      .y(w0_c1)
  );  //c1=g[0]|(p[0]&ci);
  _or2 C1_or2 (
      .a(g[0]),
      .b(w0_c1),
      .y(c1)
  );

  _and2 C2_and2 (
      .a(p[1]),
      .b(g[0]),
      .y(w0_c2)
  );  //c2=g[1]|(p[1] & g[0])|(p[1] & p[0] & ci);
  _and3 C2_and3 (
      .a(p[1]),
      .b(p[0]),
      .c(ci),
      .y(w1_c2)
  );
  _or3 C2_or3 (
      .a(g[1]),
      .b(w0_c2),
      .c(w1_c2),
      .y(c2)
  );

  //c3=g[2]|(p[2] & g[1])|(p[2] & p[1] & g[0])|(p[2] & p[1] & p[0] & ci);
  _and2 C3_and2 (
      .a(p[2]),
      .b(g[0]),
      .y(w0_c3)
  );
  _and3 C3_and3 (
      .a(p[2]),
      .b(p[1]),
      .c(g[0]),
      .y(w1_c3)
  );
  _and4 C3_and4 (
      .a(p[2]),
      .b(p[1]),
      .c(p[0]),
      .d(ci),
      .y(w2_c3)
  );
  _or4 C3_or4 (
      .a(g[2]),
      .b(w0_c3),
      .c(w1_c3),
      .d(w2_c3),
      .y(c3)
  );

  //co=g[3]
  //		| (p[3] & g[2])
  //		| (p[3] & p[2] & g[1])
  //		| (p[3] & p[2] & p[1] & g[0])
  //		| (p[3] & p[2] & p[1] & p[0] & ci);

  _and2 Co_and2 (
      .a(p[3]),
      .b(g[2]),
      .y(w0_co)
  );
  _and3 Co_and3 (
      .a(p[3]),
      .b(p[2]),
      .c(g[1]),
      .y(w1_co)
  );
  _and4 Co_and4 (
      .a(p[3]),
      .b(p[2]),
      .c(p[1]),
      .d(g[0]),
      .y(w2_co)
  );
  _and5 Co_and5 (
      .a(p[3]),
      .b(p[2]),
      .c(p[1]),
      .d(p[0]),
      .e(ci),
      .y(w3_co)
  );
  _or5 Co_or5 (
      .a(g[3]),
      .b(w0_co),
      .c(w1_co),
      .d(w2_co),
      .e(w3_co),
      .y(co)
  );

endmodule
